QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] Proving Your Devotion 6
QuestInfo.0: The last exam is about concentration.
QuestInfo.1: Close your eyes and count to 60, then talk to the apprentice. You must not move while you count, and he will only give you about 5 seconds of error.
QuestInfo.2: You've passed the last exam. Now you are an official member of the faction.
